I have also the same problem. Similarly, I want to do a mutli-site calibration at 5 hydrometric discharge stations. Based on your video, I corrected my file.cio  and print.prt as exactly as what you said. As attached files, I am sending a snapshot of my RSWAT settings and one of the 5 observed data for your consideration. I would be very thankful if you could let me know how I can correct the observed data, allowing the objective function to be calculated.  

With kind regards,
Majid
